Unlike the 2026 interims (one product group), this edition splits issued contracts into note 7 (non-participating) and note 8 (participating); the 2026 figures are the sum. Revenue and expenses from note 6 total column (p.30 revenue, p.31 expenses; 3 months). CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 7.2 (p.38) and 8.2 (p.43); new business = 7.3 (p.40) + 8.3 (p.45) totals. Each summed item records the note 7 page; the heading names the note 8 page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). RA release uses note 6 (90,812), not the AOC RA. Other revenue = รายการอื่น. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
